entities.name: NUDT19-like sequence
observations: 404-aa query sequence aligns to reviewed NUDT19 homologs with 37.2–47.9% identity and approximately 96.5–97.0% query coverage.
Homolog annotations describe Mg2+/Mn2+-dependent acyl-CoA diphosphatase activity; exact organism and activity are inferred for the query from homology.

entities.name: Acyl-CoA diphosphate hydrolysis
observations: Reference reaction: acyl-CoA + H2O → acyl-4'-phosphopantetheine + adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + 2 H+ (Rhea RHEA:50044).
Reviewed NUDT19 homolog annotations report broad CoA-ester hydrolysis; specific substrate preferences are homolog annotations, not direct measurements of the query.
